title: Building a fixation scanpath plot
description: You can read how raw gaze and fixation records become plot layers.

steps.description: You plot raw gaze coordinates as faint dots. Three list comprehensions extract fixation centroids and the measure used for marker sizing.
A gray line joins centroids in their stored order. The scatter layer places a scaled marker at each centroid.

steps.question: What numbering will the centroid annotations begin with?
steps.answer: They begin with 1 because enumerate receives a starting value of 1.

steps.description: You label each fixation, set screen-coordinate limits and add a legend before show. The recording supplies no text output or rendered figure to inspect.
